claim: Exports the follow-up log as CSV
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo?demo=1; download the follow-up CSV and inspect its header and sample row.
Fresh browser context at /demo?demo=1; download HTML and inspect the project and delivery record.

claim: Prints the current handoff or opens the browser PDF dialog
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo?demo=1; choose Print or save PDF and assert the browser print API is called.

claim: Works offline after the first visit
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo?demo=1; wait for the service worker, set offline, and reload the sample sheet.

claim: Demo data is separate from real sheets
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo?demo=1; inspect local storage namespaces.

claim: Using the demo sends no handoff details to third parties
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo?demo=1; intercept requests through the add-follow-up flow and assert same-origin only.

claim: The app uses no analytics or runtime CDNs
sandbox: Fresh browser contexts at / and /demo?demo=1; record every request and inspect loaded script, stylesheet, image, and module URLs for same-origin delivery only.

claim: Real handoffs are saved in this browser and are not sent to a server
where: Landing facts, privacy page, and README
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /app; create and save a uniquely named handoff, assert it is in the real local-storage namespace after reload, and assert all requests are same-origin.

claim: The free tool saves multiple handoffs without an account or payment
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /app; create two named handoffs, assert both persist, and assert there are no account, license, checkout, or buy controls.

claim: Only HTTP and HTTPS proof links are saved or exported
where: Delivery proof field hint and README
sandbox: Fresh demo; attempt javascript and malformed proof URLs, assert announced rejection and unchanged storage; inject legacy unsafe data and assert neither the UI nor HTML export creates an executable link.

claim: Deletes one saved handoff without deleting another, with confirmation and Undo
sandbox: Fresh real-storage context; create two handoffs, confirm deletion of one, inspect invoice-handoff-sheet:sheets, then use Undo and verify both records return.

claim: Try it with sample data opens a finished client handoff
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /; click the primary sample action and assert the demo banner, Moonbeam project, two delivery milestones, invoice MB-042, and one follow-up.

claim: Delivery proof, acceptance details, invoice details, payment instructions, and follow-ups stay together
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo?demo=1; assert every promised category is visible, save a unique payment instruction, reload, and assert the complete record remains.

claim: Reset demo restores the original sample without changing real handoffs
where: Demo banner, README, and demo documentation
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo?demo=1; seed a real record, change the sample project, reset from the banner, and assert the Moonbeam sample returns while real storage is byte-for-byte unchanged.

claim: Start for real discards the demo copy without changing real handoffs
where: Demo banner, README, and demo documentation
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo?demo=1; seed a real record, edit the demo, choose Start for real, assert the demo key is absent and real storage unchanged, then revisit the demo and assert a fresh sample is seeded.

claim: Demo navigation preserves saved sample edits until Reset demo is selected
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo?demo=1; save a unique project name, follow the header Demo link and the landing sample link, assert the edit remains, then Reset demo and assert the original sample returns.
